results.content: With the change in the hunting regulations approved by the Alabama Conservation Advisory Board, the Alabama Department of Conservation and Natural Resources’ (ADCNR) Wildlife and Freshwater Fisheries (WFF) Division expanded the opportunities to manage deer herds with an increase in the daily bag limit for does from one per day to two per day in most of the state (www.outdooralabama.com/seasons-and-bag-limits/deer-season). “We appreciate the Conservation Advisory Board and Department of Conservation and Natural Resources increasing the harvest limit for does and fully support the Hunters Helping the Hungry program,” said Alabama Farmers Federation President Jimmy Parnell.
